Load in predicted participant numbers from Measurement Core May 2025

participants_proj.Rd

Load in predicted participant numbers from Measurement Core May 2025

Usage

participants_proj(x = "MC_projections_May2025.csv")

Arguments

x

file name

Value

a tibble with this information
